messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — RC3 cut planned for today 18:00 UTC. Need final gating signoffs: QA, security, docs, and version bump verification. If you have any blockers please reply. Tagging @jordan @liam @samir @elaine :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jordan: QA smoke run starting now, will post failures in thread. ETA ~25m.

jordan: Smoke done — 3 minor flakies in auth-service integration tests, not release blockers. Tests: auth.login_flow (flaky), rate-limit (green), token-refresh (green). Filing ticket #4567 to track.

liam: Version bump PR merged into `main` (PR #789). Build artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-artifacts/1.7.0-rc3/. Changelog updated in the PR description. Docker image `redwood/api:1.7.0-rc3` verified.

samir: Quick security triage: sec-bot flagged a low-medium issue in transitive dep `xml-parser` (CVE-20xx). It's only used by legacy importer. Mitigation note added to security ticket, patch planned for next minor. For RC3: ok to proceed with documented risk — marking for conditional approval. CC @sec-bot

sec-bot: Security scan complete. No Critical/High findings. Conditional approval granted pending follow-up on legacy importer dependency.

elaine: Docs update pushed: fixed typo in release notes and added an upgrade note about token-handling change for dedicated customers. PR #791 is ready for review.

maya: Nice — putting a short checklist here. If we all give quick ✅ I'll tag and kick the release pipeline at 18:00 UTC. Please reply with a sign-off or raise blockers now.

Checklist:
- [x] Version bump PR merged (liam)
- [x] Changelog updated (liam)
- [x] Smoke QA (jordan) — 3 flakies tracked #4567
- [x] Security review (sec-bot) — conditional approval
- [x] Docs updated (elaine)
- [ ] Post-release migration notice (maya) — pending

jordan: ✅ QA sign-off (flakies tracked, not blocking).

liam: ✅ version bump & image verification done.

elaine: ✅ docs sign-off.

samir: ✅ security comfortable with conditional approval. Will follow up on patch.

maya: Thanks all. I'll run the final tag and trigger the pipeline at 18:00 UTC. Command I'll run:```
git tag -a v1.7.0-rc3 -m "RC3: pre-release"
git push origin v1.7.0-rc3
```

release-bot: Release tag v1.7.0-rc3 created by maya at 1775003000. CI pipeline started: build -> smoke -> deploy-staging. Tracking: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/57321

release-bot: CI smoke step passed. Deploy to staging queued.

maya: All looks good. I'll follow up post-staging verification and then promote to canary if green. Thanks everyone!
